product_from_film: The Codex app is presented as a place to supervise coding agents, review changes, work beside a running app and configure recurring tasks.
explains_well: The NASA example follows a visible request through file changes, a code diff and a new Picture of the Day screen in the simulator.

scenario: Add a NASA picture screen to an iOS app, adjust a fitness dashboard and configure an issue-triage automation.
product_clear_basis: The dictated NASA feature request becomes visible text and starts a task.
